trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to Xinterview
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future Launch Plan updates
trials.reasoning: The binding terms allow Xinterview to terminate or suspend an account immediately for any reason whatsoever, which materially limits the promised lifetime access. A review confirming a lifetime purchase does not override that termination right.

exhibits.quote: We may terminate or suspend your account immediately, without prior notice or liability, for any reason whatsoever, including without limitation if you breach the Terms.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access can be revoked immediately for any reason, so it is not unconditional lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: At the end of each Billing Cycle, your Subscription will automatically renew under the exact same conditions unless you cancel it or Xinterview cancels it.
exhibits.argument: The vendor describes the product as a renewable subscription it can cancel, which contradicts lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: When I purchased a lifetime license on AppSumo for this software, these awards displayed on their website obviously played a significant and reassuring role in my decision.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms purchasing a lifetime license, supporting lifetime access to Xinterview.

trials.reasoning: The official refund policy states a 14-day window, not 60 days, and other refund requests are discretionary and case-by-case. Those binding terms directly conflict with a 60-day money-back guarantee.

exhibits.quote: The policy grants new customers a 14-day window from their initial purchase date to request a refund, making the policy customer-friendly while protecting first-time buyers.
exhibits.argument: Official refund policy allows only 14 days, not 60 days.

exhibits.quote: Certain refund requests for Subscriptions may be considered by Xinterview on a case-by-case basis and granted at the sole discretion of Xinterview.
exhibits.argument: Refunds are discretionary and case-by-case, which contradicts an unconditional 60-day money-back guarantee.
